parsed.thesis: The root failure was executing a consequential artifact while relying on unverified, environment-dependent behavior: an implicitly encoded script was trusted to a specific interpreter version's compatibility. All of the Dreamer's alternatives converge on one insight — unknowns about the execution environment's hard behavioral constraints (encoding, version, platform) must be converted into knowns through cheap preflight probes, embedded into self-describing artifacts, and gated before execution, rather than discovered through consequential runtime failure. Luck and implicit compatibility are not valid execution strategies; explicit, verified environment contracts are.

principleCandidate.title: Verify environment contracts and make artifacts self-describing before consequential execution
principleCandidate.rationale: The bad decision class across all candidates is acting on an untested assumption about how the target environment interprets an artifact (e.g., Windows PowerShell 5.1 reading BOM-less UTF-8 as ANSI). A seconds-cheap probe of the environment, combined with encoding the constraint into the artifact itself (BOM, explicit -Encoding), removes dependence on version-specific luck and prevents an entire round of failed, consequential execution. Constraints that are known but not gated recur as runtime failures; converting them into preflight checks plus self-describing artifacts addresses the root cause rather than the symptom.
principleCandidate.scope: Applies whenever generating or executing artifacts (scripts, files, commands) whose behavior depends on version- or platform-specific interpretation — especially non-ASCII content, encoding, or interpreter differences — on target environments whose characteristics have not been verified in the current context. Most relevant for consequential or hard-to-reverse executions; less relevant for trivial, reversible, or already-verified environments.

risks: This principle substantially overlaps with existing core axioms: T-01 (model the system before consequential changes) and T-05 (translate hard constraints into explicit guardrails before execution); it is largely a composite application of them to encoding/interpreter-specific behavior rather than a wholly new axiom

Self-describing encodings (e.g., UTF-8 BOM) can break other consumers such as Unix tools that mishandle BOMs; the chosen contract must account for all downstream readers, not just the immediate interpreter
Mandatory preflight gates add latency to every execution; over-applying them to trivial or already-verified operations creates friction without risk reduction
Persisted environment facts (candidate 4) can become stale if the environment changes, turning a cached conclusion into a new silent failure mode
Probe-based verification covers only the probed dimension; passing an encoding echo probe does not guarantee compatibility of the full script, which can induce false confidence

principleDraft.title: Probe environment contracts and self-describe artifacts before consequential execution
principleDraft.statement: Before generating or executing any consequential artifact whose interpretation depends on environment-specific behavior (character encoding, interpreter version, platform), the agent must (1) verify the relevant environment contract with a cheap read-only preflight probe against the actual target environment (e.g., non-ASCII round-trip echo, interpreter version query), (2) encode the verified contract into the artifact itself so it is self-describing (e.g., UTF-8 with BOM, explicit -Encoding flag), and (3) gate execution on the probe's confirmation — never rely on implicit compatibility luck or on behavior observed only in a different environment or version.
principleDraft.rationale: The root cause of the diagnosed failure was acting on an untested assumption about how the target environment interprets an artifact: a BOM-less UTF-8 script was trusted to Windows PowerShell 5.1, which decoded it as ANSI and corrupted the execution. A seconds-cheap probe converts the environment unknown into a known, and a self-describing artifact removes dependence on version-specific decoding defaults entirely. Constraints that are known but not gated recur as runtime failures; probe-plus-gate addresses the root cause instead of the symptom of post-execution corruption.
applicability: Generating or executing scripts, files, or commands containing non-ASCII content on environments whose encoding behavior has not been verified in the current context
Writing artifacts interpreted by version-sensitive interpreters or shells (e.g., Windows PowerShell 5.1 vs PowerShell 7+, cmd vs bash) whose defaults differ
Consequential or hard-to-reverse executions whose success depends on platform-, version-, or locale-specific interpretation
Cross-platform file generation where downstream consumers may differ in BOM and code-page handling
antiPatterns: Executing a consequential script containing non-ASCII characters written without an explicit encoding contract, assuming the interpreter will auto-detect it correctly
Treating 'it worked in my environment or a different version' as evidence of compatibility on the target environment
Discovering encoding or interpreter incompatibilities only through consequential runtime failure (mojibake, corrupted output) after the action has already run
Relying on implicit defaults (BOM-less UTF-8, locale-dependent code pages) for artifacts consumed by multiple interpreters
Caching a one-time environment conclusion and reusing it indefinitely after the environment may have changed

intentContract.ownerIntent: The Owner wants to prevent consequential executions from failing because the agent guessed, instead of verifying, how the target environment would decode or interpret an artifact — e.g., a BOM-less UTF-8 script being read as ANSI by Windows PowerShell 5.1.
intentContract.targetBehavior: Before writing or executing a consequential environment-dependent artifact, the agent's tool trajectory shows a cheap read-only probe of the actual target environment (e.g., echoing a non-ASCII string and verifying round-trip fidelity, querying interpreter version) and the artifact being written with an explicit self-describing contract (e.g., UTF-8 with BOM or explicit encoding flags), with execution proceeding only after the probe confirms the contract.
intentContract.forbiddenBehavior: Executing consequential scripts or files whose non-ASCII content or interpreter-version compatibility was never verified against the target environment, so that incompatibility surfaces only as runtime corruption (mojibake, wrong output) after the consequential action has already run.
intentContract.evidenceSource: The diagnosed pain: a script with non-ASCII content was written BOM-less and handed to Windows PowerShell 5.1, which decoded it as ANSI, corrupting the execution — an entire round of consequential work failed on an unprobed environment contract.
intentContract.validationExpectation: An evaluator should accept a rule as faithful only if it demands observable preflight evidence against the actual target environment plus an explicit encoding contract embedded in the artifact before consequential execution; a rule that merely instructs 'check the encoding' without requiring a probe of the real environment, or that permits proceeding on cross-environment assumptions, should be flagged as unfaithful.

risks: Substantial overlap with core axioms T-01 (build a sufficient model before consequential changes) and T-05 (translate hard constraints into explicit guardrails before execution); this principle is largely a composite application of them to encoding/interpreter contracts, so downstream rules may be redundant with existing axiom-derived rules

Self-describing encodings such as UTF-8 BOM can break other downstream consumers (e.g., Unix tools that mishandle BOMs); the chosen contract must account for all readers, not just the immediate interpreter, and a generated rule must not hard-code BOM as universally correct
Mandatory preflight gates add latency; over-application to trivial, reversible, or already-verified operations creates friction without risk reduction
Persisted environment facts can become stale if the environment changes, turning a cached conclusion into a new silent failure mode
A probe verifies only the probed dimension — passing a non-ASCII echo probe does not guarantee full script compatibility and may induce false confidence
Rule generation may over-generalize this into 'probe everything before every action,' producing unfalsifiable or excessively costly rules that evaluators cannot distinguish from compliance theater

principleDraft.title: Gate consequential script execution on verified interpreter and encoding contracts
principleDraft.statement: Before creating or executing any consequential artifact whose interpretation depends on version- or platform-specific behavior, first establish the target environment's contract as a non-skippable preflight gate: probe the target interpreter's identity and version (e.g., $PSVersionTable.PSVersion or Get-Command powershell/pwsh) and its encoding behavior, then make the artifact self-describing (UTF-8 with BOM or an explicit -Encoding parameter) whenever it contains non-ASCII characters, or select an interpreter verified compatible with the artifact; never let the first consequential execution serve as the compatibility test for a known constraint.
principleDraft.rationale: The diagnosed root cause was a missing mandatory preflight gate: the agent wrote a UTF-8 no-BOM PowerShell script containing Chinese text and executed it under Windows PowerShell 5.1, which deterministically decodes BOM-less UTF-8 as ANSI — a documented constraint — producing garbled output ('鐢熸垚鏃堕棿锛') and forcing a full rework under pwsh 7. A seconds-cheap version probe combined with an explicit encoding contract removes dependence on interpreter-version luck and prevents the entire failed execution round. Hard constraints that are known but not front-loaded as gates recur as runtime failures across sessions; gating on verified environment contracts addresses the root cause rather than the garbled-output symptom.
applicability: Creating or executing scripts, files, or commands whose behavior depends on interpreter version, platform, or encoding — especially PowerShell scripts containing non-ASCII (e.g., Chinese) content on Windows
Consequential or hard-to-reverse executions targeting an environment whose interpreter version or encoding contract has not been verified in the current session
Cross-interpreter or cross-runtime script execution (Windows PowerShell 5.1 vs pwsh 7+, cmd, bash) where decoding behavior differs by version
Boundary: does not require preflight for trivial, reversible operations or environments already verified in the current session
antiPatterns: Executing a non-ASCII script on an unverified interpreter and using the consequential run itself as the compatibility test
Leaving artifact encoding implicit (BOM-less UTF-8 containing non-ASCII text) and trusting that the interpreter version happens to be compatible
Knowing a documented platform constraint (e.g., Windows PowerShell 5.1 reading BOM-less UTF-8 as ANSI) but skipping the check and relying on memory or luck
Remediating only after garbled runtime output by switching interpreters, instead of verifying the contract before the first execution

intentContract.ownerIntent: The Owner wants the agent to confirm the target interpreter's version and encoding compatibility before writing or executing scripts on Windows (especially scripts with non-ASCII content), so that known incompatibilities like PowerShell 5.1 misreading BOM-less UTF-8 are caught by a preflight gate rather than by failed consequential runs.
intentContract.targetBehavior: Before creating or executing a non-ASCII script on Windows, the agent's tool trajectory shows a cheap preflight probe identifying the target interpreter (e.g., $PSVersionTable.PSVersion or Get-Command powershell/pwsh) followed by an explicit encoding contract — writing UTF-8 with BOM, passing an explicit -Encoding parameter, or selecting a verified-compatible interpreter — before the consequential execution occurs.
intentContract.forbiddenBehavior: Creating or executing a version- or encoding-sensitive artifact (e.g., a BOM-less UTF-8 PowerShell script with Chinese content) on an unverified interpreter with implicit encoding, letting the consequential run itself serve as the compatibility test and remediating only after runtime failure produces garbled output.
intentContract.evidenceSource: Diagnosis manual_1788417947835_e99ujtms: Windows PowerShell 5.1 executed a UTF-8 no-BOM script with Chinese content and garbled the output ('鐢熸垚鏃堕棿锛'), forcing rework under pwsh 7; the agent admitted no pre-execution compatibility check was done and subsequently recorded an owner instruction to confirm interpreter and encoding compatibility before landing scripts on Windows (agent_turn 2026-09-03T06:05:07.757Z; tool_call_failure 2026-09-03T06:00:16.593Z).
intentContract.validationExpectation: An evaluator should accept a rule as faithful only if it demands a preflight interpreter/encoding verification before consequential execution of non-ASCII scripts on Windows and rejects trajectories where such a script runs on an unverified interpreter with implicit encoding; the rule must not be so broad that it demands preflight probes for every trivial command, nor so narrow that it hardcodes the exact 5.1/BOM incident without capturing the underlying environment-contract gate.

parsed.thesis: 文件写入方与执行解释器之间存在隐式契约——编码、运行时版本、平台默认值。当这类契约未被显式化并在有后果的执行前验证时，跨边界执行会以乱码等沉默方式失败，且只能靠事后返工来发现。Dreamer 的全部候选共同指向：应把隐式环境契约转化为固定的写入策略（如 UTF-8 with BOM）或显式的解释器选择（pwsh 7），配合低成本预检探测与执行后的输出核对，在不兼容暴露之前就消除它。

principleCandidate.title: 将隐式环境契约显式化：有后果执行前固定并验证编码与解释器契约
principleCandidate.rationale: 根因是写入者默认『UTF-8 无 BOM 会被任何解释器一致解析』，而 Windows PowerShell 5.1 实际按 ANSI 解析——这是一个从未被任何环节检查的隐式契约。将编码契约固化为写入策略、或显式选择已知兼容的解释器，并在执行前用可逆的低成本探测验证、执行后立即核对输出，可将失败模式的发现时点从『乱码暴露后的返工』提前到『执行前的门禁』，以最低成本消除已知不兼容。
principleCandidate.scope: 适用于任何『产物写入方』与『消费解释器』默认值可能不一致的场景：跨 Windows/Linux 分发含非 ASCII 内容的脚本或配置、PowerShell 5.1 与 pwsh 7 混用环境、被不同版本工具读取的数据文件，以及对运行时版本或编码敏感的有后果执行。

risks: 与核心公理存在部分重叠：T-01（先建模再变更）、T-04（不确定时用可逆探测）、T-05（硬约束转为显式护栏）、T-07（执行后验证）各自覆盖了本原则的一个侧面；本原则是它们在编码/运行时契约场景下的具体化，采纳时应作为特化规则而非独立新公理
统一采用 UTF-8 with BOM 并非普适安全：不容忍 BOM 的消费方（部分 Unix 工具链、shebang 处理、某些解析器）可能因此失败，编码契约需按具体写入方-读取方对确定，而非机械套用单一编码
预检门禁若只验证解释器版本而不覆盖实际失败模式（如控制台代码页、重定向输出编码），会产生虚假安全感，误以为契约已验证
对低风险、易回滚的操作强制执行预检与编码策略会引入不必要开销，违背 T-06 的最简干预要求，需按后果严重性分级应用

principleDraft.title: 显式化编码与解释器契约：有后果执行前固定、探测并核对
principleDraft.statement: 当写入的产物（脚本、配置、数据）将被另一个解释器或工具消费、且双方默认值（字符编码、运行时版本、平台约定）可能不一致时，必须：①将契约显式化——固化为按消费方验证过的写入策略（如按写入方-读取方对确定是否带 BOM）或显式指定已知兼容的解释器（如 pwsh 7）；②在有后果的执行前用低成本、可逆的探测验证契约覆盖实际失败模式（解析正确性、控制台代码页、输出编码），而非仅核对版本号；③执行后立即核对输出无乱码或异常，未核对不得视为成功；④按后果严重性分级应用，对低风险、易回滚的操作不强制全量预检。禁止依赖任何未经验证的隐式默认契约直接执行。
principleDraft.rationale: 根因是写入方默认『UTF-8 无 BOM 会被任何解释器一致解析』，而 Windows PowerShell 5.1 实际按 ANSI 解析——该隐式契约从未被任何环节检查，失败只能在乱码暴露后靠事后返工发现。将契约前置显式化（固定写入策略或显式选择解释器），配合执行前可逆探测与执行后输出核对，把失败发现时点从『乱码暴露后的返工』提前到『执行前的门禁』，以最低成本在已知不兼容暴露之前消除它，避免沉默失败。
applicability: 跨 Windows/Linux 分发含非 ASCII 内容的脚本或配置文件
PowerShell 5.1 与 PowerShell 7 (pwsh) 混用环境下写入或执行 .ps1 脚本
写入将被不同版本工具或解释器读取的数据/配置文件，且对编码或版本语义敏感
对运行时版本、字符编码、控制台代码页、重定向输出编码敏感的有后果执行
antiPatterns: 依赖隐式默认值：写入含非 ASCII 内容的产物而不指定编码策略，假设任何解释器都会一致解析
以 UTF-8 无 BOM 写入含非 ASCII 字符的脚本后直接交由 Windows PowerShell 5.1 执行，不做任何预检
仅核对解释器版本号即宣称契约已验证，不探测实际失败模式（控制台代码页、重定向输出编码、非 ASCII 解析）
执行后不核对输出是否乱码或异常即视为成功
机械地对所有写入统一套用单一编码（如盲目全部加 BOM）而不按具体写入方-读取方对确定契约

intentContract.ownerIntent: 避免代理凭隐式默认值假设写入方与解释器在编码、运行时版本上兼容，导致跨解释器执行以乱码等沉默方式失败并需事后返工。
intentContract.targetBehavior: 代理在写入将被解释器消费的含非 ASCII 内容的产物前，可被观察到：显式确定编码写入策略或显式指定兼容解释器（如 pwsh 7）；在有后果的执行前运行低成本可逆探测（如含非 ASCII 字符的探针脚本经目标解释器解析）验证实际失败模式；执行后立即核对输出无乱码或异常。
intentContract.forbiddenBehavior: 在写入方与解释器之间的环境契约未经显式化与验证的情况下直接执行有后果操作——例如以 UTF-8 无 BOM 写入含中文的脚本后交由 Windows PowerShell 5.1 执行且不做预检，直到乱码暴露后才返工。
intentContract.evidenceSource: Dreamer/Philosopher 的诊断：UTF-8 无 BOM 写入的含非 ASCII 脚本被 Windows PowerShell 5.1 按 ANSI 解析导致乱码，该隐式编码契约未被任何环节检查，属于写入方-解释器跨边界的沉默失败，只能事后返工发现。
intentContract.validationExpectation: 评估者应要求规则同时体现四点：①执行前显式化契约（按写入方-读取方对确定编码策略，或显式指定解释器）；②预检探测覆盖实际失败模式（解析、代码页、输出编码）而非仅版本号；③执行后输出核对；④按后果严重性分级、对低风险可逆操作不强加全量预检。若规则退化为『一律加 BOM』的机械规则，或对低风险操作强制全量预检（违背 T-06），应判定为不忠实并标记而非直接采纳。

risks: 与核心公理部分重叠：T-01（先建模）、T-04（可逆探测）、T-05（硬约束转显式护栏）、T-07（执行后验证）各自覆盖本原则的一个侧面；本原则应作为它们在编码/解释器契约场景下的特化规则落地，而非新增独立公理，否则会造成公理冗余
统一采用 UTF-8 with BOM 并非普适安全：不容忍 BOM 的消费方（部分 Unix 工具链、shebang 处理、某些解析器）可能因此失败；编码契约必须按具体写入方-读取方对确定，规则生成时若退化为单一编码策略会引入新失败面
预检门禁若只验证解释器版本而不覆盖实际失败模式（控制台代码页、重定向输出编码），会产生虚假安全感，误判契约已验证
对低风险、易回滚的操作强制执行预检与编码策略会引入不必要开销，违背 T-06 最简干预要求，规则需内置按后果严重性分级的豁免，否则可能被评估为过度保守
规则过严可能导致代理为规避风险而拒绝跨平台写入任务，或过度依赖探针脚本本身引入新的隐式假设（探针执行环境与真实执行环境不一致）

candidates.betterDecision: 写脚本前先用一行探测命令（如 $PSVersionTable 或 which pwsh）确认实际执行的解释器版本，再据此决定编码契约：若为 5.1 则写 UTF-8 with BOM，若为 pwsh 7 才可用无 BOM UTF-8
candidates.rationale: 5.1 将无 BOM 文件按 ANSI 解码是确定性已知行为，一条版本探测只需数秒，而跳过它导致一次必然失败的执行与完整返工周期

candidates.badDecision: 把已知的编码不兼容问题留给运行时失败去暴露，没有在执行有后果的脚本前设置任何预检门禁
candidates.betterDecision: 建立不可跳过的预检门禁：凡脚本含非 ASCII 字符且将在 Windows 上执行，必须先确认解释器版本与编码策略（BOM 或显式 -Encoding 参数）并显式声明，才能进入执行阶段
candidates.rationale: 将已知平台约束前置为显式检查关卡，把必然失败的执行模式转化为廉价的事前验证步骤，符合把硬约束翻译为不可跳过检查的要求

candidates.badDecision: 在 Windows 平台上以无 BOM UTF-8 写入含中文的脚本文件，编码契约完全隐式依赖解释器默认行为
candidates.betterDecision: 在 Windows 上落地含非 ASCII 字符的脚本时，始终写入带 BOM 的 UTF-8（或显式传 -Encoding UTF8），或将中文字符串移到以显式编码读取的数据/参数中，使编码契约与解释器版本解耦
candidates.rationale: BOM 是 Windows PowerShell 5.1 唯一可靠的 UTF-8 识别信号；显式编码声明在 5.1 与 pwsh 7 下都能消除歧义，使脚本可移植

candidates.badDecision: 把首次真实执行当作对环境假设的试验，未先以可逆的小探针验证编码往返是否正确
candidates.betterDecision: 执行正式脚本前，先跑一个最小探针（在目标解释器下打印一条中文字符串并回读），确认编码往返无损后再执行有后果的操作
candidates.rationale: 可逆的探针以近乎零成本验证环境契约，在造成实际后果前保留中止能力；执行成功不等于假设正确，验证必须先行

candidates.badDecision: 对『5.1 与 pwsh 编码差异』这类确定性平台行为没有任何预置知识，只能靠一次失败被动学到后才补记规则
candidates.betterDecision: 主动将此类平台级确定性约束固化为常驻指令与工具模板（Windows 落地脚本前强制确认解释器与编码兼容性），在失败发生前就内化为不可跳过的前置规则

parsed.thesis: 确定性的环境不兼容不应由失败来揭示：当平台行为（如解释器版本对无 BOM 文件的解码规则）是可预知且可用数秒级探测确认时，有后果的执行必须先通过显式的预检门禁——探测解释器版本、显式声明编码契约、以可逆探针确认往返无损——并将此类确定性平台约束固化为长期规则，从而把必然失败的执行与返工周期转化为廉价的事前验证。

principleCandidate.title: 预检门禁：有后果执行前以廉价探测显式化环境契约
principleCandidate.rationale: 根因是让编码契约隐式依赖解释器默认行为，而该行为是确定性且可预知的。一条版本探测、一个 BOM 或显式编码声明、一次可逆往返探针，成本以秒计，却能阻断一次必然失败的执行与完整返工；再将门禁固化为常驻规则，避免每次靠失败重新发现同一约束。
principleCandidate.scope: 适用于在存在版本相关确定性行为的平台上执行含平台敏感内容（非 ASCII 字符、编码契约、解释器/运行时差异）的有后果操作，尤其是检查成本近为零而失败代价为完整返工的场景；不适用于无已知平台敏感性或后果可忽略的琐碎操作。

risks: 与现有核心公理高度重叠：本原则实质是 T-01（先建模再行动）、T-04（可逆探针优先）、T-05（硬约束转不可跳过门禁）、T-08（摩擦转长期规则）在编码/平台契约场景下的合取，需评估是否构成对公理体系的冗余稀释
过度门禁风险：对低风险、易回滚的操作强制预检会引入不成比例的摩擦，与 T-06（最小干预）产生张力
『带 BOM』并非普适安全解：BOM 会破坏部分 Unix 工具、YAML/JSON 解析与 shebang 脚本，盲目加 BOM 可能在跨平台流转时引入新故障
预检结果可能过时或探测本身失效（探测命令不可用、执行环境与探测环境不一致），缓存的环境结论需与实际执行上下文绑定

principleDraft.title: 预检门禁：有后果执行前以廉价探测显式化环境契约
principleDraft.statement: 在具有版本相关确定性行为的平台上执行含平台敏感内容（非 ASCII 字符、编码契约、解释器/运行时差异）的有后果操作前，必须先通过显式预检门禁：①探测实际执行将使用的解释器/运行时版本；②显式声明编码契约（依据目标平台选择 BOM 或显式编码声明，而非依赖默认解码）；③以可逆探针确认写读往返无损。门禁未通过则禁止执行主操作并先修复契约；已确认的确定性平台约束必须固化为长期规则。禁止以执行失败作为发现环境不兼容的手段。
principleDraft.rationale: 根因是让编码契约隐式依赖解释器/运行时的默认行为，而该行为是确定且可预知的。一次版本探测、一个显式编码声明、一次可逆往返探针，成本以秒计，却能阻断一次必然失败的执行与完整返工；将门禁固化为常驻规则，可避免每次靠失败重新发现同一约束。本原则是 T-01（先建模）、T-04（可逆探针优先）、T-05（硬约束转不可跳过门禁）、T-08（摩擦转长期规则）在编码/平台契约场景下的具体化操作。
applicability: 在解释器/运行时版本会确定性地改变行为（如对无 BOM 文件的解码规则）的平台上执行写文件、构建、部署等有后果操作
操作内容含非 ASCII 字符或隐含编码契约（源码、配置、数据导出等），且失败代价为完整返工或不可逆后果
检查成本以秒计（版本探测、编码声明、往返探针）而失败代价高昂的场景
首次在某环境执行，或环境（解释器版本、locale、默认编码）可能已发生变化的重复操作
antiPatterns: 让编码契约隐式依赖解释器/运行时的默认行为（如依赖特定版本对无 BOM 文件的默认解码规则）
跳过预检直接执行平台敏感的有后果操作，以运行失败作为发现环境不兼容的手段
探测已显示确定性不兼容后仍按原方案执行，触发本可避免的失败与完整返工
每次通过失败重新发现同一平台约束而不将其固化为长期规则
把『加 BOM』当作普适安全解，不评估其对部分 Unix 工具、YAML/JSON 解析与 shebang 脚本的破坏
对无平台敏感性、后果可忽略的琐碎操作机械套用全量预检门禁，引入不成比例的摩擦

intentContract.ownerIntent: Owner 希望有后果的平台敏感执行（尤其涉及非 ASCII 内容与编码契约）不再因隐式依赖解释器默认行为而必然失败并引发完整返工，而应被秒级预检在事前拦截并将确认的约束固化为规则。
intentContract.targetBehavior: 在工具轨迹中可见：执行主操作前先探测目标解释器/运行时版本、显式选择并声明编码契约（BOM 或显式编码声明）、以可逆读写往返探针确认无损，且仅当探针通过后才执行主操作；已确认的确定性平台约束被写入持久化规则。

principleDraft.title: 预检门禁：有后果执行前显式确认环境契约（解释器版本与编码）
principleDraft.statement: 凡执行有后果的操作且其内容含平台敏感要素（非 ASCII 字符、编码契约、解释器/运行时版本差异），而相关平台行为是确定性可预知的，必须先通过不可跳过的预检门禁：以廉价探测确认目标解释器/运行时版本，据探测结果显式声明并落实编码契约（如带 BOM 的 UTF-8 或显式编码参数），必要时以可逆探针验证编码往返无损，之后才允许执行；并将已确认的确定性平台约束固化为常驻规则，禁止以运行失败作为发现已知环境不兼容的手段。
principleDraft.rationale: 根因是让编码契约隐式依赖解释器默认行为，而该行为（如 Windows PowerShell 5.1 将无 BOM 文件按 ANSI 解码）是确定且可预知的。一次版本探测（$PSVersionTable / which pwsh）加一条显式编码声明，成本以秒计，却能阻断一次必然失败的执行与完整返工；再把该门禁固化为常驻规则，避免每次靠失败重新发现同一平台约束。
applicability: 在 Windows 等存在版本相关确定性编码行为的平台上，创建或执行含非 ASCII 字符（如中文）的脚本
跨解释器/运行时（如 Windows PowerShell 5.1 与 pwsh 7）执行有后果操作，且检查成本近为零、失败代价为完整返工的场景
写入或修改携带编码契约假设、并将被确定性解释器或工具链消费的文件（脚本、配置、数据文件）
将已确认的平台级确定性约束沉淀为常驻指令或工具模板的记忆维护场景
antiPatterns: 依赖运行失败来暴露已知（或可廉价确认）的环境不兼容——『靠报错学环境』
编码契约隐式依赖解释器默认行为，如以无 BOM UTF-8 写入含中文脚本后直接交给 Windows PowerShell 5.1 执行
把首次有后果的真实执行当作对环境假设的试验
仅在事后补记经验，而不将已确认的确定性平台约束前置为不可跳过的门禁

intentContract.ownerIntent: Owner 要求 Agent 在 Windows 上创建或执行含非 ASCII 字符的脚本前，必须先确认目标解释器版本与编码契约（5.1 需带 BOM 的 UTF-8 或显式 -Encoding 参数），不得靠运行失败来发现编码不兼容而返工。
intentContract.targetBehavior: 在创建或执行含非 ASCII 字符的 PowerShell（或跨解释器）脚本前，工具轨迹中可见顺序化预检：先探测解释器版本（如 $PSVersionTable、which pwsh），据此显式选定并声明编码契约（BOM 或显式编码参数），必要时先以中文字符串往返探针验证，然后才执行有后果的命令。
intentContract.forbiddenBehavior: 在有后果的执行前跳过环境预检：不探测目标解释器版本、不显式声明编码契约，以隐式编码假设直接执行含非 ASCII 内容的脚本，让确定性的平台不兼容（如 Windows PowerShell 5.1 将无 BOM 文件按 ANSI 解码）由运行失败来揭示。
intentContract.evidenceSource: diagnosis_manual_1788417947835_e99ujtms 及其证据链：Windows PowerShell 5.1 执行 UTF-8 无 BOM 中文脚本按 ANSI 解码产生乱码失败（tool_call_failure 2026-09-03T06:00:16.593Z），Agent 自认未做事前兼容性检查，返工改用 pwsh 7 后才成功，并记录『Windows 上落地脚本前先确认解释器与编码兼容性』为 owner 指令。
intentContract.validationExpectation: 评估者应核实派生规则同时具备：触发条件（有后果执行 + 内容含非 ASCII/平台敏感要素 + 目标平台存在已知确定性行为）、必需动作（版本探测与显式编码声明，可选可逆探针）、禁止项（以隐式编码假设直接执行）；并核实规则既未被放宽为对所有操作一律预检，也未被窄化为『一律加 BOM』——编码契约的选择必须依据探测到的解释器版本。

risks: 与核心公理 T-01/T-04/T-05/T-08 高度重叠：本原则实质是它们在平台/编码契约场景下的具体化合取；落地时必须以场景化的门禁顺序（探测版本→显式契约→可逆验证→固化为常驻规则）为增量价值，否则构成对公理体系的冗余稀释
过度门禁风险：对低风险、易回滚或无平台敏感性的琐碎操作强制预检会引入不成比例的摩擦，与 T-06（最小干预）冲突；适用边界必须守住『有后果 + 平台敏感 + 检查成本近为零』三条件
『带 BOM』并非普适安全解：BOM 可破坏部分 Unix 工具、YAML/JSON 解析与 shebang 脚本；派生规则必须要求依据探测到的解释器显式选定契约，而非机械加 BOM
预检结论可能过时或探测环境与实际执行环境不一致（探测命令不可用、缓存结论失效）；规则应要求探测结论与实际执行上下文绑定，不得信任跨会话未绑定的环境缓存
